def test_squeeze_view(self, device):
        t = torch.ones(5, 1, 5, device=device)
        v = torch.squeeze(t)
        self.assertTrue(self.is_view_of(t, v))
        v[0, 1] = 0
        self.assertEqual(t, v._base)
